moments.author: Barack Obama
moments.quote: He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.
moments.why: The scorching rally quip has sparked a meme frenzy and political backlash ahead of midterms.

moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: For you to say it’s a Cheesecake Factory, that just shows why you are a lousy president.
moments.why: Trump’s fiery response keeps the mocking exchange trending in political feeds.

moments.author: Thibaut Courtois
moments.quote: will not travel to Barcelona and is definitely OUT for El Clásico due to flu
moments.why: A last‑minute withdrawal from El Clásico shocked fans and fueled match‑day chatter.

moments.author: Sal Frelick
moments.quote: Sal Frelick hits game‑tying home run in World Series Game 2
moments.why: That clutch homer electrified fans and cemented him as a postseason hero.
